knowledge_graph.title: Volusia County Property Appraiser
knowledge_graph.type: Government office in New Smyrna Beach, Florida
knowledge_graph.address: 124 N Riverside Dr, New Smyrna Beach, FL 32168
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "The primary mission of the Volusia County Property Appraiser is to fairly and equitably discover, list, and value all real and tangible personal property in Volusia County for the purpose of creating the annual ad valorem tax roll in accordance with applicable Florida Statutes and Florida Department of Revenue Substantive Regulations. Our secondary mission involves assisting our public (citizens, cities, independent taxing authorities and county government) in accessing and utilizing the tremendous real estate/economic database, maps, and other associated information which we continuously maintain and update."

related_questions.question: What is the difference between a tax assessor and a tax appraisal?
related_questions.snippet: Put simply, assessed value is the amount your local government thinks your home is worth; it's what is used to determine property taxes. Appraised value, though, is the amount a professional home appraiser thinks your home is worth; it's typically used by lenders when considering a mortgage application.
